name: show_recipe_card
description: Display a cocktail recipe card on the guest's screen so they can follow along while you talk. ALWAYS prefer passing the drink's `id` (from get_cocktail_details, find_cocktails_by_ingredient, suggest_by_mood, search_cocktail_by_name, or random_cocktail) — the card then fetches the exact, accurate recipe itself. Only fall back to passing name/ingredients/steps inline when you're describing a drink that has no id (e.g. an improvised or substituted build). This does not return anything; just call it whenever you recommend or start walking through a drink.

parameters.description: The cocktail to show. Pass `id` whenever you have one.

id.description: TheCocktailDB drink id returned by a cocktail tool, e.g. "11007". When present, the card fetches the canonical recipe and the other fields are ignored.

name.description: Drink name. Used only when no id is available (improvised builds).

glass.description: Recommended glass, e.g. "Coupe". Only used when no id is given.

image.description: Optional image URL. Only used when no id is given.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines. Only used when no id is given.

steps.description: Ordered preparation steps in plain language. Only used when no id is given.
